To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new flow pattern map is proposed for horizontal micro-fin tubes with different helix angles.
a flow pattern map for horizontal micro-fin tube considering the effect of tube helix angle is developed and it shows good agreement with visualization and literature data.

the flow pattern maps developed by Wojtan et al. (2005), which are used to predict flow boiling in micro-fin tubes with different helix angles, have been modified to consider the effect of the early transition to an annular flow due of micro-fin geometry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a flow pattern map for horizontal micro-fin tubes, which can be used for flow boiling heat transfer and two-phase flow instability studies in the tubes.
the development of the flow pattern map in horizontal micro-fin tube for flow boiling of the refrigerant.

the flow pattern of flow boiling in the horizontal micro-fin tubes with different helix angles, which can help to understand the flow pattern transition in the micro-fin tubes and provide a reference for the design of micro-fin tubes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model is a promising approach to predicting the flow patterns in micro-fin tubes.
the modified flow pattern map for the micro-fin tubes can be used to predict flow boiling in the micro-fin tubes.
the proposed flow pattern map is able to predict the flow patterns in smooth and micro-fin horizontal tubes with 0, 10 and 18°helix angle.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed model can be used to estimate the flow pattern of R410A for the micro-fin tubes with various helix angles.
the proposed map can be used as a reliable tool to predict the flow patterns in micro-fin tube for the design and optimization of the evaporators in the refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.
the modified map could be used to describe the flow pattern transitions in the horizontal smooth and micro-fin tube.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the flow pattern transition in horizontal micro-fin tube with different helix angles can be predicted using the modified map.

the flow pattern transition in the horizontal smooth and micro-fin tube can be described by the same flow pattern map, which is modified from that of the horizontal smooth tubes, and the helix angle of micro-fin tube can influence the flow pattern transition.
the proposed flow pattern map can be used as a basis to improve the prediction of the two-phase flow pattern for flow boiling of refrigerants in micro-fin tubes.
